notes: Server-verified license activation with device binding, plus a first-run gate: a PC with no license shows the activation form, an expired/revoked one shows the reason, and the app revalidates at startup without ever bricking itself on a day without internet. The hub can now issue licenses (renew/suspend/revoke) together with the hospital Admin + HR sign-in accounts shown once. This release ships the Windows build only; Linux installs stay on v1.0.3 until a Linux build is cut. Launcher fix: silent 'no working version' on fresh installs resolved, and the launcher now runs windowless (single app window).
